code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=max(set(x for r in g for x in r), key=lambda x:sum(v==x for r in g for v in r))
    marks=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c] not in (9,)]
    # From each isolated marker, project toward the closest line of the frame color (9), in cardinal directions.
    for r,c,v in marks:
        opts=[]
        for dr,dc in ((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc; d=1
            while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
                if g[rr][cc]==9:
                    opts.append((d,dr,dc)); break
                rr+=dr; cc+=dc; d+=1
        if not opts: continue
        _,dr,dc=min(opts)
        rr,cc=r,c
        while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and g[rr][cc]!=9:
            g[rr][cc]=v if (rr,cc)!=(r,c) else 4
            rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    return g
'''
